Fake currency notes are familiar in India. But what about fake coins?
In September 2026, police busted an alleged counterfeit coin manufacturing network operating out of Haryana, uncovering a factory equipped with heavy machinery, specialised dies and thousands of fake ₹20 coins. Investigators say the network stretched across several states and that the accused claimed to have manufactured and circulated counterfeit coins worth more than ₹70 crore.
